Quick Answer

Nil T2 filing here is $300.00 plus HST per tax year, one price for one tax year, covering the return, its schedules where required, a CPA Ontario review and electronic transmission by a registered EFILE electronic filer. Both Figures, and No Argument From Either

The two prices in the table above sit either side of each other, and this page draws no conclusion from which is which. That is not reticence: a published price is a figure, and a figure cannot support a claim about what the money buys.

A higher published price can reflect work a lower one does not include, and a lower one can reflect a narrower job. Neither direction can be read off the number, and the record we hold for the right-hand column is a number with nothing attached. So the table states both and stops there.

What the left-hand column can do is account for itself line by line, because every one of those lines is published on this site. The section below does exactly that.

What the Fee Here Covers

A figure cannot say what it buys, so here is what the fee on this site buys, in full:

  • The T2 itself, and GIFI Schedules 100, 125 and 141 where the corporation has anything to report.
  • Schedule 50 for any shareholder at 10% or more, Schedule 24 on a first return, and Schedule 8 with loss continuity carried forward intact.
  • Preparation and review by a CPA Ontario member before anything is transmitted.
  • Transmission by a registered EFILE electronic filer, prepared and transmitted in Canada, with credentials never shared and never used offshore.
  • Form T183CORP signed on a secure screen, and the CRA confirmation emailed within 3 business days.
  • One price for one tax year for one corporation, with no tier above or below it.

A year that turns out not to be nil is not covered by this fee. A holding corporation with investment income, a rental corporation and a corporation that paid or received a dividend are not nil. Those are handled by Gondaliya CPA Professional Corporation at gondaliyacpa.ca at $350.00 plus HST per year.

Gondaliya CPA Professional Corporation is a registered EFILE electronic filer. Returns are prepared and transmitted in Canada. Credentials are never shared and never used offshore.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the difference in price?

Nil T2 filing here is $300.00 plus HST per tax year. The H&R Block figure recorded on September 20, 2026 is $449.00. Both are above, as published on their dates.

When was the H&R Block price checked?

September 20, 2026, recorded by Sharad Gondaliya, CPA. Prices change, so the date sits above the table and its own site is the place to confirm the current figure.

Does the higher figure mean more is included?

The published price we hold does not say what it includes, so this page does not claim either way. A figure on its own cannot answer that in either direction.

Why does the table not draw a conclusion?

Because the record for one column is a price with no description attached, and a comparison built on that would not be provable.

What does your fee include?

The T2, GIFI Schedules 100, 125 and 141 where required, Schedule 50, Schedule 24 on a first return, Schedule 8 and loss continuity, a CPA Ontario review, and electronic transmission, at $300.00 plus HST per tax year.

Is there a cheaper tier here?

No. There is one price for a nil year, and no tier above or below it.

Who actually files the return here?

Gondaliya CPA Professional Corporation, a registered EFILE electronic filer. Returns are prepared and transmitted in Canada.

My corporation is a holding company. Is that nil?

Not if investment income was credited in the year. A holding corporation with investment income is not nil, and nor is a rental corporation or one that paid or received a dividend.

What if my year is not nil after all?

Then this fee does not cover it. It moves to Gondaliya CPA Professional Corporation at gondaliyacpa.ca at $350.00 plus HST per year.

Where can I see the whole fee?

On the nil T2 filing cost page, which states the fee and everything inside it.
